title: Cathie Wood's weekly recap: pivots to XE nuclear play, Amazon, sells AMD
content:
Joe Raedle

Cathie Wood's Ark Invest showed a rotation into large-cap tech and next-generation energy exposure while trimming positions across semiconductors, industrial automation, and space communications names during the last week.

The most notable divestment came in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD]), where Ark's ARKF (ARKF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKF]), ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]), ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]), ARKW (ARKW [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKW]), and ARKX (ARKX [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKX]) funds collectively sold over 215K shares worth an estimated $74M. 

In contrast, Ark aggressively accumulated Amazon.com (AMZN [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN]) across five funds, adding 283.9K shares worth close to $74M, underscoring strong conviction in the consumer internet and cloud infrastructure sector.

Ark also made a substantial allocation toward clean energy innovation through X-Energy (XE [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/XE]), an Amazon (AMZN)-backed nuclear startup. The portfolio manager bought over 4.02M shares across ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]), ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]), and ARKX (ARKX [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKX]) ETFs. Assuming an estimated price of $30 per share, the total investment amounts to more than $120M.

Within aerospace, defense, and communications, ARKX (ARKX [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKX]) increased exposure to Kratos Defense and Security Solutions (KTOS [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/KTOS]) and added DoorDash (DASH [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/DASH]), while the fund sold over 114K shares of Iridium Communications (IRDM [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/IRDM]).

In a comparatively lightly traded week, other moves included the sale of over 32K shares of Teradyne (TER [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TER]) and 113K shares of Rocket Lab (RKLB [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/RKLB]), pointing to reduced exposure to space launch businesses. In the genomics segment, ARKG (ARKG [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKG]) sold more than 30K shares of Twist Bioscience (TWST [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TWST]).

title: Twist Bioscience to Report Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Financial Results on Monday, May 4, 2026
content:
Company to host conference call at 8:00 AM ET

Investor Day Scheduled for May 21, 2026

SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., April 21, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Twist Bioscience Corporation (NASDAQ: TWST), a mid-cap growth and value biotech company, today announced that it will issue its financial results for the fiscal 2026 second quarter ended March 31, 2026, before the opening of the market on May 4, 2026. The company plans to hold a conference call and live audio webcast for analysts and investors at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results and provide an update on the company’s business. The press release with the financial results will be accessible from the company’s website prior to the conference call through the Investor Relations section under the "Company" tab at www.twistbioscience.com. Twist will also host an Investor Day for analysts and institutional investors on Thursday, May 21, 2026.

Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Financial Results Conference Call Details

The conference call will be webcast live through the Investor Relations section under the "Company" tab at www.twistbioscience.com. Those parties interested in participating via telephone must register on the Company’s Investor Relations website or by clicking here. Upon registration, all telephone participants will receive the dial-in number along with a unique PIN number that can be used to access the call. To avoid delays, we encourage participants to dial into the conference call fifteen minutes ahead of the scheduled start time. The webcast replay will be available for two weeks.

Investor Day to take place May 21, 2026

Twist will host an Investor Day for analysts and institutional investors on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The event will feature a tour of the company’s manufacturing facility, showcase of automation, multiple customer talks, as well as presentations from several Twist senior leaders highlighting the company’s strategic initiatives, growth opportunities and roadmap ahead. The webcast of management presentations will begin at 11:00 am PT.

Investor Day Webcast Details

The Investor Day will be webcast live through the Investor Relations section under the "Company" tab at www.twistbioscience.com. The webcast replay will be available for two weeks. Institutional investors and analysts who are interested in attending in person should reach out to Angela Bitting, SVP, Corporate Affairs.

About Twist Bioscience Corporation

At Twist Bioscience, our customizable solutions across the biological continuum raise the bar in diagnostics, therapeutics, industrial, agriculture and research markets.

Story Continues

We drive innovation with confidence, without compromise. Whether delivering oligos, genes, proteins, libraries, characterization data, antibody discovery solutions, or NGS workflow tools, our scientific expertise and exceptional customer experience help navigate complex challenges, all with precision and at the scale and speed customers require. By enhancing R&D efficiency at every turn, we give scientists more shots on goal – more experiments, more iterations, more chances for remarkable discoveries.

Together, we stand with customers in the relentless pursuit of progress, backed by enterprise reliability, to shape a healthier and more sustainable future for all. For more information about our products and services, please visit www.twistbioscience.com.

title: Cathie Wood's ARK boosts Palantir, Tesla, Roninhood bets; cuts semiconductor exposure
content:
Joe Raedle

Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest funds executed a broad rotation across technology, healthcare, and industrial names during the last week while markets remained volatile over broader geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran.

Buying activity for the portfolio manager was led by Palantir Technologies (PLTR [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/PLTR]), Tesla (TSLA [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA]), and Robinhood Markets (HOOD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HOOD]), while the largest sales came from Strata Critical Medical (SRTA [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/SRTA]), Teradyne (TER [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TER]), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD]), and BWX Technologies (BWXT [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/BWXT]).

Digging deeper into sector-wise moves, Ark increased exposure to AI and data analytics platforms. In autonomous technology, Kodiak AI (KDK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/KDK]) saw 31,291 shares accumulated exclusively in ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]).

Moving to electric vehicles and mobility, Tesla (TSLA [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA]) remained a core conviction buy, with over 79K shares added across ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]), ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]), and ARKX (ARKX [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKX]), increasing exposure by $28M [https://seekingalpha.com/news/4573611-cathie-wood-buys-the-dip-in-tesla-with-fresh-28m-investment]. Cathie Wood has consistently underscored autonomous driving as the cornerstone of ARK’s long-term thesis on Tesla (TSLA [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA]) and currently has over $880M worth of exposure to the stock.

In fintech & digital platforms, the portfolio manager added over 182K shares of Robinhood Markets (HOOD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HOOD]) across ARKF (ARKF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKF]), ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]), and ARKW (ARKW [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKW]), with an estimated value close to $12.7M. In contrast, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ICE]) saw 6.9K shares worth ~$1.2M being sold from ARKF (ARKF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKF]), indicating a shift away from traditional exchange infrastructure toward next-generation fintech platforms. Besides, LY Corp (YAHOF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/YAHOF]) (YAHOY [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/YAHOY]), a Japanese internet conglomerate, also saw 9.8K shares sold, reflecting trimming of international platform exposure.

Genomics & healthcare strategies showed selective buying, with ~49K shares of GeneDx (WGS [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/WGS]) bought and 8.2K shares of Arcturus Therapeutics (ARCT [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARCT]) added. On the sell side, Twist Bioscience (TWST [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TWST]) saw a disposal of 60K shares, while most notably, Strata Critical Medical (SRTA [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/SRTA]) witnessed a massive 355K share sell-off. Genomic diagnostics company Veracyte (VCYT) also made it to the sell list.

The firm remained a net seller in semiconductors & automation; it dropped over 44K shares of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD]), reversing the buy trend seen in February. Semiconductor test equipment maker Teradyne (TER [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TER]) saw over 68K shares dropped across ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]) and ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]) worth close to $11M, maintaining the selling spree over the last few months.

Over 36K shares of BWX Technologies (BWXT [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/BWXT])—a nuclear technology and defense-focused industrial company—were sold across ARKK (ARKK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKK]) and ARKQ (ARKQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ARKQ]). Other sell trades include uranium producer Cameco (CCJ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/CCJ]) and streaming platform company Roku (ROKU [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ROKU]).

title: Twist Bioscience Adds Invenra Bispecific Platform To Broaden Discovery Opportunity
content:
Track your investments for FREE with Simply Wall St, the portfolio command center trusted by over 7 million individual investors worldwide.

Twist Bioscience (NasdaqGS:TWST) entered a licensing agreement with Invenra Inc. to co-exclusively provide Invenra's B-Body bispecific antibody platform. The deal broadens Twist's antibody discovery offerings across in vivo, in vitro, and AI-enabled workflows. Twist also gains a direct ownership stake in Invenra and potential future revenue participation from bispecific discovery services and licensing.

For you as an investor, this move adds another building block to Twist Bioscience's role in biologics discovery, where demand for targeted therapies and more complex antibody formats continues to grow. By integrating Invenra's bispecific platform into its existing discovery services, Twist is positioning its core synthetic biology and antibody capabilities as a broader toolkit for pharma and biotech customers.

The agreement also introduces an equity component and future revenue sharing tied to bispecific programs, which connects part of Twist's opportunity set to the potential commercial use of this platform. As the bispecific antibody segment develops, investors may monitor how Twist translates this technology access into customer uptake, partnerships, and new discovery programs.

Stay updated on the most important news stories for Twist Bioscience by adding it to your watchlist or portfolio. Alternatively, explore our Community to discover new perspectives on Twist Bioscience.NasdaqGS:TWST Earnings & Revenue Growth as at Feb 2026

2 things going right for Twist Bioscience that this headline doesn't cover.

This licensing deal gives Twist Bioscience a more complete antibody discovery stack, from target identification through to more complex bispecific formats. For pharma and biotech customers that are already using Twist for synthetic DNA, libraries, or NGS tools, having the B-Body bispecific antibody platform under the same roof can make it easier to run larger, multi-format discovery campaigns with one provider instead of stitching together multiple vendors such as AbCellera, Genmab, or other antibody specialists. The co-exclusive setup with Invenra also lets Twist stay directly involved in how the platform is commercialized rather than just acting as a behind the scenes supplier.

How This Fits Into The Twist Bioscience Narrative

The Invenra agreement aligns with the narrative of Twist widening its customer base and product set by adding bispecific antibodies to its DNA and NGS offering and making the platform more useful for large pharma and biotech programs. The added cash and stock commitments, alongside Twist's existing unprofitable status and goals for future breakeven, may affect near term cash usage, which is one of the concerns already raised in the narrative. The co exclusive revenue sharing on bispecific licensing and services introduces a new revenue stream that is not clearly broken out in the existing storyline and may change how investors think about the future mix between tools, services, and partnered programs.

Story Continues

Knowing what a company is worth starts with understanding its story.  Check out one of the top narratives in the Simply Wall St Community for Twist Bioscience to help decide what it is worth to you.

The Risks and Rewards Investors Should Consider

⚠️ The deal adds cash and stock outlays, and analysts already note that Twist is loss making with a path to profitability that is not guaranteed, so investors may want to watch for any increase in funding needs or dilution. ⚠️ Bispecific antibody discovery is a competitive field, and if customer uptake of the B Body platform is slower than expected, the return on Twist's equity stake and licensing economics could be limited. 🎁 Twist receives all bispecific discovery and license revenue that flows through Twist, with only a 20% royalty back to Invenra on license revenue, which may support higher value deals if customer demand for bispecifics is strong. 🎁 The approximate 6% equity position in Invenra creates a second way to benefit from any success of the B Body platform, alongside direct service and licensing income.

What To Watch Going Forward

From here, you might focus on how quickly Twist signs bispecific discovery projects, whether any of them convert into downstream licensing deals, and how management discusses the contribution of this platform on future calls. It will also be important to see how this agreement fits alongside Twist's broader push in synthetic DNA and NGS tools, and whether the additional spending tied to the Invenra deal affects progress toward the company’s profitability objectives.

title: Twist Bioscience to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences
content:
SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., February 18, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Twist Bioscience Corporation (NASDAQ: TWST), a mid-cap growth and value biotech company, today announced that Emily M. Leproust, Ph.D., CEO and co-founder of Twist Bioscience, and Adam Laponis, CFO of Twist Bioscience, will participate in fireside chats at the following upcoming investor conferences.

TD Cowen 46th Annual Health Care Conference on Tuesday, March 3 in Boston, MA; fireside chat at 1:50 pm Eastern Time Barclays 28th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, March 10 in Miami, FL; fireside chat at 3:00 pm Eastern Time Leerink Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, March 11 in Miami, FL; fireside chat at 8:40 am Eastern Time

The fireside chats will be webcast live and can be accessed by visiting the "Investor Calendar" page of the investor relations section of the company's website here. Replays of the fireside chats will be archived for a period of 30 days following the conclusion of the live events.

About Twist Bioscience Corporation

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of customers who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as medicine, agriculture, industrial chemicals and defense, by using our synthetic DNA tools, our customers are developing ways to better lives and improve the sustainability of the planet. The faster our customers succeed, the better for all of us, and Twist Bioscience is uniquely positioned to help accelerate their efforts.
